question: What is the atomic number of Carbon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Carbon has six protons in its nucleus, which is why its atomic number is 6.**
 
• The atomic number is the number of protons in an atom&a
